questions.question:
Choose the address that is exactly the same as the one given below.

B-6, Lotus Enclave, Patliputra Colony, Patna, Bihar - 800013 ?

options.text: B-6, Lotus Enclave, Patliputra Colony, Patna, Biharr - 800013
B-6, Lotus Enclave, Patliputra Colony, Patna, Bihar - 800013
B6, Lotus Enclave, Patliputra Colony, Patna, Bihar - 800013
B-6, Lotus Enclave, Patliputra Colony, Patna, Bihar - 800031

questions.solution:
Given: B-6, Lotus Enclave, Patliputra Colony, Patna, Bihar - 800013

Option 1) B-6, Lotus Enclave, Patliputra Colony, Patna, __**Biharr**__ - 800013 → Incorrect

Option 2) B-6, Lotus Enclave, Patliputra Colony, Patna, Bihar - 800013→ Correct

Option 4) B-6, Lotus Enclave, Patliputra Colony, Patna, Bihar - __**800031**__→ Incorrect

Thus, the address in option 2 is exactly similar to the given address.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Instruction: Identify the assumptions that must hold for the statement to be valid, then choose the correct option.

Statement: The successful deployment of the new quantum satellite has provided empirical evidence for long-distance entanglement, but it also creates opportunities for developing unhackable global communication networks.

Assumptions:

I. Quantum satellites offer a new method for global communication.

II. The theory of entanglement has been fully utilized by this deployment.

III. Further research into quantum entanglement will lead to breakthroughs in cybersecurity. ?

options.text: Only I and II are implicit
Only II and III are implicit
Only I and III are implicit
All I, II, and III are implicit

questions.solution:
Given statement: The successful deployment of the new quantum satellite has provided empirical evidence for long-distance entanglement, but it also creates opportunities for developing unhackable global communication networks.

Assumptions:

I. Quantum satellites offer a new method for global communication. ⇒ Implicit

The statement links the satellite's development to opportunities for global communication networks, which presumes that quantum satellite can be used as a communication method. 

II. The theory of entanglement has been fully utilized by this deployment. ⇒ Not Implicit

The statement does not suggest that the theory of entanglement has been fully utilized, only that that the evidence has been demonstrated. 

III. Further research into quantum entanglement will lead to breakthroughs in cybersecurity. ⇒ Implicit

The statement mentions that unhackable global communication networks assumes that further development of quantum entanglement will contribute to advance in cybersecurity.

Thus, Only I and III are implicit.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.

Statement: All metals are solids. Some solids are hard materials.

Conclusions: I. Some metals are hard materials.

II. All hard materials are metals. ?
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/329eb7fc97a3a629fe4f71c38470a8abdc592e2c4088e53886f344b8d2eaae5d.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some metals are hard materials → Does not follow (As all metals are solids and some solids are hard materials. So it is possible but not definite)

II. All hard materials are metals → Does not follow (As all metals are solids and some solids are hard materials. So it is possible but not definite)

∴ Here, Neither I nor II follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question: If 6 @ 2 = 38 and 3 @ 4 = 13, then what is the value of 5 @ 3?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

6 @ 2 = 38 → (6)2 + 2 ⇒ 36 + 2 = 38

And,

3 @ 4 = 13 → (3)2 + 4 ⇒ 9 + 4 = 13

Similarly,

5 @ 3 → (5)2 + 3 ⇒ 25 + 3 = 28

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.

questions.question: If 5 ! 5 = 100 and 6 ! 6 = 144, what is the value of 8 ! 8?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

​5 ! 5 = 100 → (5 + 5)² ⇒ (10)² = 100

And,

6 ! 6 = 144 → (6 + 6)2 ⇒ (12)2 = 144 

Similarly,

8 ! 8 → (8 + 8)2 ⇒ (16)2 = 256 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.

questions.question: In a group of 100 students, 40 percent are boys. If 80 percent of the boys passed the final examination, how many boys failed? ?
questions.solution:
According to the question:

Total students → 100

Total boys → 100 × 40% = 40

Total boys passed the final examination → 40 × 80% = 32

Total boys failed the final examination → Total boys - Total boys passed the final examination

→ 40 - 32 = 8

Hence, **"Option 1"** is the correct answer.
